page.overview:
Who is Larry?

Larry was an employee at Eddie Carr's garage, responsible for painting the Mercedes-Benz M-Class vehicles. He had some difficulty with his paint sprayer and needed Eddie and Ian Malcolm's assistance in getting the vehicle he was working on painted. He accidentally sprayed himself in the face with it.
